info.name: ProxyPay API Tutorial — New Developer Onboarding
info.description:
# 🚀 ProxyPay Interactive API Tutorial

Welcome! This collection walks you through the complete developer journey in under 30 minutes.

## What you'll learn
1. **Register & Authenticate** — get a JWT token
2. **KYC Verification** — submit identity documents to unlock transactions
3. **Deposit** — fund your mobile money wallet
4. **Withdraw** — cash out to a mobile money number

## Before you start
- Import the companion environment file `mobile_money.postman_environment.json`
- Make sure the API server is running locally: `npm run dev` (default: http://localhost:3000)
- Run requests **in order** — each step stores data that the next step needs

## Estimated time: ~20 minutes

item.name: Step 1 — Register & Authenticate
item.description:
## Step 1: Register & Authenticate

Authentication in ProxyPay is phone-number based. You send your phone number and receive a JWT token.

The test script below **automatically saves** the returned token into the `token` environment variable so every subsequent request uses it without any copy-pasting.

**Expected result:** HTTP 200 with a `token` field in the response.

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Auto-save the JWT token for all subsequent requests
// The test tab runs automatically after every response.
// We grab the token from the response and store it in the environment.
console.log('✅ Token saved to environment variable: token');

request.description:
Sends a phone number to get a JWT access token.

**How it works:**
- ProxyPay uses phone-number-based auth (no passwords).
- The server returns a signed JWT token valid for 1 hour.
- The **Tests** tab script automatically saves the token to the `token` environment variable.

**What to check in the response:**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGci...",
  "userId": "uuid-here"
}
```

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Confirm the token we saved is actually valid

request.description:
Validates the JWT token you received.

**Why this matters:** Before making any protected API calls, it is good practice to confirm your token is active. If this returns `valid: false`, go back to step 1.1 and re-login.

**Expected response:**
```json
{ "valid": true }
```

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Confirm authentication works for protected routes
// Save stellar address if available — needed for deposit/withdraw

header.description: JWT token automatically inserted from the environment variable saved in step 1.1

request.description:
Fetches your authenticated user profile.

**Notice** the `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` header — this is the pattern used by every protected endpoint in ProxyPay.

The Tests script also saves your `stellarAddress` and `userId` for later steps.

item.name: Step 2 — KYC Verification
item.description:
## Step 2: KYC (Know Your Customer) Verification

ProxyPay enforces KYC before allowing outbound transactions. There are three levels:

| Level  | Daily Limit (XAF) | Requirements |
|--------|-------------------|--------------|
| None   | 0 XAF             | No verification — receive-only |
| Basic  | 100,000 XAF       | ID document |
| Full   | 10,000,000 XAF    | ID + address + biometrics |

In this tutorial we complete **Basic KYC** (sufficient to run the deposit/withdraw steps).

**Steps:**
1. Create an applicant record with your personal details
2. Upload a document (passport / ID / driving licence)
3. Start a verification workflow run
4. Check the verification status

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Save the applicant ID returned by the KYC provider
// The applicant ID is used in subsequent KYC steps

request.description:
Creates a KYC applicant record linked to your user account.

**Behind the scenes:** ProxyPay forwards this data to the Entrust Identity Verification provider and stores the returned `applicant_id` in the `kyc_applicants` table.

**The Tests script** saves the `applicantId` to your environment automatically.

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Pre-request: make sure applicantId exists before sending
console.warn('⚠️  applicantId not set. Did you run step 2.1 first?');
console.log('📄 Document uploaded. Proceed to step 2.3 to start the verification workflow.');

request.description:
Uploads a base64-encoded identity document image to the KYC provider.

**Supported document types:** `passport`, `national_identity_card`, `driving_licence`

**Sandbox tip:** Entrust provides pre-approved test document images in their sandbox dashboard. For this tutorial the placeholder base64 string above is sufficient to progress through the flow.

**File size limit:** Max 10 MB per the API global payload limit.

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Save the workflow run ID for status polling
console.log('✅ Workflow run ID saved:', workflowRunId);
console.log('⏳ Verification is now processing. Run step 2.4 to check status.');

request.description:
Triggers the verification workflow for the applicant.

**What happens:** The KYC provider runs automated checks (liveness, document authenticity, data matching) and asynchronously updates the applicant's status via webhook.

**In sandbox mode** verification typically completes within seconds. In production it can take minutes to hours.

**Next:** Poll step 2.4 until you see `verification_status: approved`.

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Display current KYC level and transaction limits
// Warn the user if KYC is still pending
console.warn('⚠️  KYC level is still "none". Verification may still be processing.');
console.warn('   Wait a moment and re-run this request, or check step 2.3.');
console.log('✅ KYC approved! You can now proceed to Step 3 (Deposit).');

item.name: Step 3 — Deposit
item.description:
## Step 3: Deposit Funds

Now that your account is KYC-verified, you can deposit funds from a mobile money number into your ProxyPay wallet.

**How it works:**
1. ProxyPay initiates a mobile money pull request from the specified phone number
2. The mobile money provider (MTN, Orange, Airtel, etc.) processes the payment
3. Funds are credited to the linked Stellar wallet address
4. A transaction record is created and can be queried

**Idempotency:** Every deposit/withdraw request requires a unique `Idempotency-Key` header. Postman's `{{$guid}}` variable generates a new UUID automatically for each request — preventing accidental duplicate transactions.

exec: console.error('❌ No token found. Go back to step 1.1 and login first.');
console.warn('⚠️  userId not set. Make sure step 1.3 ran successfully.');
// ✅ TUTORIAL — Save the transaction ID for step 3.2
console.log('   Run step 3.2 to check transaction status.');
console.warn('⚠️  Could not extract transactionId from response. Check the response body.');

header.description: IMPORTANT: A unique key per request. Postman generates a new UUID automatically via {{$guid}}. This prevents duplicate transactions if the request is retried.

request.description:
Initiates a deposit from a mobile money number to your ProxyPay wallet.

**Key concepts:**
- `amount`: In XAF. Basic KYC allows up to 100,000 XAF/day.
- `provider`: The mobile money operator (`mtn`, `orange`, `airtel`).
- `Idempotency-Key`: Prevents duplicate transactions — always unique per request.
- `stellarAddress`: The on-chain address that receives the funds.

**What to expect:**
- Status `202 Accepted` — transaction is queued and being processed
- Status `200 OK` — transaction completed immediately (sandbox)
- The `transactionId` in the response is saved automatically for step 3.2

exec: console.log('✅ Deposit confirmed! Proceed to Step 4 (Withdraw).');
console.log('⏳ Still processing. Re-run in a moment.');

request.description:
Fetches the details and current status of the deposit transaction.

**Transaction statuses:**
- `pending` — being processed by the mobile money operator
- `completed` — funds successfully credited
- `failed` — transaction could not be completed (check `failureReason`)
- `cancelled` — manually cancelled before processing

**Re-run this request** until you see `completed` before moving to the withdrawal step.

item.name: Step 4 — Withdraw
item.description:
## Step 4: Withdraw Funds

Withdrawal sends funds FROM your ProxyPay wallet TO a mobile money number.

**This is the reverse of deposit:**
- Funds are debited from your Stellar wallet
- The equivalent XAF amount is pushed to the target mobile money number

**Prerequisites:**
- KYC level must be `basic` or `full`
- Your wallet must have sufficient balance (deposited in Step 3)
- Same `Idempotency-Key` requirement as deposits

exec: // ✅ TUTORIAL — Guard: confirm a deposit was completed before withdrawing
console.error('❌ No token. Start from step 1.1.');
console.log('✅ Withdraw transaction ID saved:', txId);
console.log('   Run step 4.2 to verify it completed.');

header.description: Unique per request — prevents duplicate withdrawals

request.description:
Initiates a withdrawal from your ProxyPay wallet to a mobile money number.

**Important notes:**
- `amount` must not exceed your wallet balance or your daily KYC limit
- The `Idempotency-Key` header is required — a new UUID is generated per send via `{{$guid}}`
- `provider` must match the mobile network of the destination `phoneNumber`

**Failure reasons to watch for:**
- `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` — deposit more first
- `KYC_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` — amount exceeds daily KYC limit
- `INVALID_PHONE` — phone number format is incorrect

exec: console.log('🎉 Congratulations! You have completed the ProxyPay developer tutorial.');
console.log('   You successfully: registered → verified KYC → deposited → withdrew.');
console.log('⏳ Still processing. Re-run in a moment.');

request.description:
Polls the withdrawal transaction until it reaches a terminal state.

**When you see `status: completed`** — you have successfully completed the full ProxyPay developer flow:

✅ Registered → ✅ KYC verified → ✅ Deposited → ✅ Withdrawn

**Next steps:**
- Explore the `mobile_money_core` collection for advanced endpoints (bulk transactions, vaults, contacts)
- Read `docs/KYC_INTEGRATION.md` for full KYC documentation
- Check `docs/JWT_AUTHENTICATION.md` for token refresh patterns
